_comment: Scoring rules by year range. `to: null` means open-ended. The importer stamps these onto each Session; the validator reads them back from the database, never from here. Add a new range here if the league changes the format again.

eras.name: Early era
eras.description: Four matches a season, one at each club, all singles. Eight men a side, Nassau scoring: 3 points per opponent (front nine, back nine, overall), 9 points max per man. 1945 had three clubs and three matches. Allegheny Country Club held the fourth seat 1946-1954.

eras.name: Middle era
eras.description: The modern weekend format, but only team results survive for most years. Player rows exist for 2000 and 2001; the rest are still to be transcribed.

eras.name: Modern era
eras.description: Full player-by-player rows for every session (2011 excepted). Friday singles, Saturday foursomes and four-ball, Sunday singles, one host club per session on a fixed rotation.

slotOverrides._comment: Years where the Saturday order was flipped. Keyed by year, then ordinal -> format.

sessionOverrides._comment: Per-session overrides keyed by session id (year-ordinal). Use when a session was played with a different team size or points. Example: {"1947-2": {"matchesPerPairing": 10, "note": "..."}}. Nothing is overridden until you add an entry.
